title: Recovery of Overpayments at Practice Level under Network Participation Agreements
content:
Overpayments under **Network Participation Agreements** belong to the practice, the customer that holds the agreements. They are measured across all of that practice's agreements.

## Practice receivable

The practice receivable is the total of the open amounts of all open overpayment cases of the practice, across every agreement it holds. It is measured as of the current date. Each case's open amount is its notice amount less every withholding, refund and reduction booked against it.

## Clauses of this rule

**1. Where an overpayment may be offset.** This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis: *Overpayments are recovered at the level of the practice (the customer that holds the agreements): an open overpayment under one agreement may be offset against remittances under any active or termination pending agreement of the same practice.*

**2. Order and limit of offsets.** This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis: *Open overpayments of the practice are offset in the recoupment order (oldest notice first), and the total withheld from one remittance may not exceed the recoupment percentage of that remittance's claim payments.*

**3. After the last agreement ends (in force).** Once every agreement of the practice has terminated, remaining open overpayments are billed to the practice for refund instead of offset.

## The recoupment percentage stays valid

Only the handling basis of clause 2 is retired. The figure it named, each agreement type's recoupment percentage, stays valid as a figure of the product's payment integrity table: 100 percent under the Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement and 50 percent under each of the other five agreement types.

## Points of judgement on clause 3

| Agreements of the practice (hypothetical) | Remaining open overpayments are |
|---|---|
| One agreement active, one terminated | Not yet billed under clause 3 (not every agreement has terminated) |
| Both agreements terminated | Billed to the practice for refund instead of offset |

superseded_clauses: Overpayments are recovered at the level of the practice (the customer that holds the agreements): an open overpayment under one agreement may be offset against remittances under any active or termination_pending agreement of the same practice.

Open overpayments of the practice are offset in recoupment_order (oldest notice first), and the total withheld from one remittance may not exceed recoupment_max_pct_per_remittance of that remittance's claim payments.
